title: 농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 농림축산식품부 (정보통계담당관실-농업경영체등록), 044-201-1416, 1410
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Information and Statistics Division - Agricultural Business Registration ), 044-201-1416, 1410

rows.source_ko: 농림축산식품부 (청년농육성정책팀-농업법인 등), 044-201-1534, 1537
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Young Farmer Promotion Policy Team - Agricultural Corporations, etc. ), 044-201-1534, 1537

rows.source_ko: 농림축산식품부 (식량산업과-공동농업경영체), 044-201-1837, 1838
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Food Industry Division - Joint Agricultural Management Entities ), 044-201-1837, 1838
Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Income and Welfare Division ), 051-773-5465, 5466

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion and Support of Agricultural and Fisheries Management Entities and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(등록대상 농어업경영정보) ① 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 별표 1 제10호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 정보”란 다음 각 호의 정보를 말한다. 다만, 제6호ㆍ제7호 및 제8호(품목별 판매처와 그 비율에 관한 정보로 한정한다)의 정보는 해당 정보주체가 등록에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 등록대상 정보에서 제외할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2013. 6. 12., 2014. 8. 7., 2015. 7. 7., 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 12. 1., 2021. 9. 30., 2026. 6. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information Subject to Registration) ① The term “information prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Item 10 of Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of Agricultural and Fisheries Management Entities (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) refers to the information set forth in each of the following items. However, information under Items 6, 7, and 8 (limited to information regarding sales outlets and their ratios by item) may be excluded from the information subject to registration if the relevant data subject does not consent to the registration. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 12, 2013; Aug. 7, 2014; July 7, 2015; Dec. 27, 2018; Dec. 1, 2020; Sep. 30, 2021; Jun. 18, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업경영 관련 교육 이수정보
rows.text_en: 1. Information on Completion of Agricultural Management-Related Education

rows.source_ko: 2. 「후계농어업인 및 청년농어업인 육성ㆍ지원에 관한 법률」 제8조제1항에 따른 후계농업경영인 선정정보
rows.text_en: 2. Information on the selection of successor agricultural managers pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Promotion and Support of Successor Farmers and Fishermen and Young Farmers and Fishermen

rows.source_ko: 3. 농업에 관련된 융자ㆍ보조금 등의 수령정보
rows.text_en: 3. Information on receiving loans, subsidies, etc. related to agriculture

rows.source_ko: 4. 「농림축산식품부 소관 친환경농어업육성 및 유기식품 등의 관리ㆍ지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제10조 및 제53조에 따른 유기식품등 인증 및 무농약농산물ㆍ무농약원료가공식품의 인증 정보
rows.text_en: 4. Certification information for organic foods, etc. and certification information for pesticide-free agricultural products and processed foods made from pesticide-free raw materials pursuant to Articles 10 and 53 of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Promotion of Environmentally Friendly Agriculture and Fisheries and the Management and Support of Organic Foods, etc. under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
5. Deleted <March 24, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 6. 연간 소득에 관한 정보(농업법인만 해당한다): 농업 소득과 농업 외 소득을 말하며, 농업 외 소득을 정확하게 알지 못하거나 알 수 없는 경우에는 대강의 추정값을 등록할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: 6. Information on annual income (applicable only to agricultural corporations): Refers to agricultural income and non-agricultural income. If non-agricultural income is not known or cannot be known, a rough estimate may be registered.

rows.source_ko: 7. 자산 및 부채(負債)에 관한 정보(농업법인만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Information on assets and liabilities (applicable only to agricultural corporations)

rows.source_ko: 8. 직접 생산 활동을 하지 아니하는 농업법인의 농산물 유통ㆍ가공에 관한 정보: 유통ㆍ가공 대상 품목, 품목별 연간 판매액, 품목별 판매처와 그 비율에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 8. Information on the distribution and processing of agricultural products by agricultural corporations not engaged in direct production activities: Information on items subject to distribution and processing, annual sales by item, and sales outlets and their proportions by item

rows.source_ko: 9. 농업용 면세유류의 유종별 배정량에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 9. Information on the Allocation Quantities of Tax-Exempt Agricultural Fuel by Fuel Type

rows.source_ko: 10. 「임업 및 산촌 진흥촉진에 관한 법률」 제17조에 따른 임업후계자 선발 및 독림가 선정에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 10. Information on the selection of forestry successors and the selection of exemplary foresters pursuant to Article 17 of the Act on the Promotion of Forestry and Mountain Villages

② In Article 2 , Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “information prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the information set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 20, 2012; March 24, 2013; July 3, 2013; December 18, 2017; September 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 어업경영 관련 교육 이수정보
rows.text_en: 1. Information on completion of fisheries management-related training

rows.source_ko: 2. 「후계농어업인 및 청년농어업인 육성ㆍ지원에 관한 법률」 제8조제1항에 따른 후계어업경영인 선정정보
rows.text_en: 2. Information on the selection of successor fisheries managers pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Promotion and Support of Successor Farmers and Fishermen and Young Farmers and Fishermen

rows.source_ko: 3. 어업에 관련된 융자ㆍ보조금 등의 수령정보
rows.text_en: 3. Information on receipt of loans, subsidies, etc. related to fisheries

rows.source_ko: 4. 「해양수산부 소관 친환경농어업 육성 및 유기식품 등의 관리ㆍ지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제8조 및 제39조에 따른 유기식품의 인증 및 무항생제수산물등의 인증 정보
rows.text_en: 4. Certification information for organic food and antibiotic-free seafood, etc. pursuant to Articles 8 and 39 of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Promotion of Environmentally Friendly Agriculture and Fisheries and the Management and Support of Organic Food, etc. under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: 5. 연간 어업 소득에 관한 정보(어업법인의 경우에는 그 법인의 어업 소득을, 어업인의 경우에는 자기의 어업 소득과 세대원 중 어업인의 어업 소득을 합산한 소득을 말하며, 어업 소득을 정확하게 알지 못하거나 알 수 없는 경우에는 그 추정 값을 말한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Information on annual fisheries income (in the case of a fisheries corporation, the corporation's fisheries income; in the case of a fisherman, the sum of his/her own fisheries income and the fisheries income of any household member who is a fisherman; if the fisheries income is not precisely known or cannot be known, the estimated value shall be used)

rows.source_ko: 6. 연간 어업 외 소득에 관한 정보(어업법인의 경우에는 그 법인의 어업 외 소득을, 어업인의 경우에는 자기의 어업 외 소득과 세대원 중 어업인의 어업 외 소득을 합산한 소득을 말하며, 어업 외 소득을 정확하게 알지 못하거나 알 수 없는 경우에는 그 추정 값을 말한다)
rows.text_en: 6. Information on annual non-fishing income (in the case of a fisheries corporation, this refers to the corporation's non-fishing income; in the case of a fisherman, this refers to the sum of their own non-fishing income and the non-fishing income of any household member who is a fisherman; if the non-fishing income is not accurately known or cannot be known, this refers to an estimated value)

rows.source_ko: 7. 자산 및 부채에 관한 정보(어업법인의 경우에는 그 법인의 자산 및 부채를 말하며, 어업인의 경우에는 자기의 자산 및 부채와 세대원 중 어업인의 자산 및 부채를 각각 합산한 것을 말한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Information on assets and liabilities (in the case of a fisheries corporation, this refers to the assets and liabilities of the corporation; in the case of a fisherman, this refers to the sum of their own assets and liabilities and the assets and liabilities of household members who are fishermen)

rows.source_ko: 8. 생산수산물의 유통에 관한 정보 중 유통 대상 품종, 품종별 연간 생산량ㆍ생산금액 및 품종별 판매처와 그 비율에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 8. Information regarding the distribution of produced fishery products, including species subject to distribution, annual production volume and value by species, and sales outlets and their ratios by species

rows.source_ko: 제3조(농업경영정보의 등록) ① 농업경영체는 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제4조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에 따라 농업경영 관련 정보(이하 “농업경영정보”라 한다)를 등록하려면 별지 제1호서식 또는 별지 제2호서식의 등록신청서를 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 자에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 농업경영정보 중 임야와 관련된 정보를 등록하려면 별지 제1호의2서식 또는 별지 제2호의2서식의 등록신청서를 산림청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 3. 24., 2018. 12. 27., 2021. 9. 30., 2024. 3. 18., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Registration of Agricultural Management Information) ① In order to register information related to agricultural management (hereinafter referred to as “agricultural management information”) pursuant to the first part other than each subparagraph of Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Promotion and Support of Agricultural and Fisheries Management Entities (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), an agricultural management entity shall submit a registration application form in Annex No. 1 or Annex No. 2 to the person designated according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. However, if an agricultural management entity wishes to register information related to forest land among the agricultural management information , it shall submit a registration application form in Annex No. 1-2 or Annex No. 2-2 to the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service. <Amended Mar. 24, 2016; Dec. 27, 2018; Sep. 30, 2021; Mar. 18, 2024; July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「농업ㆍ농촌 공익기능 증진 직접지불제도 운영에 관한 법률」 제7조에 따른 기본형공익직접지불금 또는 같은 법 제22조에 따른 선택형공익직접지불금(이하 “직불금”이라 한다)의 신청을 하지 아니하는 경우: 국립농산물품질관리원장
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where an application is not made for the Basic Public Interest Direct Payment pursuant to Article 7 of the Act on the Operation of the Direct Payment System for the Promotion of Public Interest Functions in Agriculture and Rural Areas or the Optional Public Interest Direct Payment pursuant to Article 22 of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as “Direct Payment”): Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service

rows.source_ko: 2. 직불금의 신청을 하는 경우: 농지 소재지 관할 읍장ㆍ면장 또는 동장(이하 이 조 및 제4조에서 “읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장”이라 한다)이나 국립농산물품질관리원장
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of applying for direct payments: the head of the Eup, Myeon, or Dong having jurisdiction over the location of the farmland (hereinafter referred to as “head of Eup, Myeon, or Dong” in this Article and Article 4 ) or the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service

rows.source_ko: ② 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장은 제1항제2호에 따라 등록신청서를 제출받으면 그 제출받은 날부터 14일 이내에 등록신청서를 제5조에 따른 농어업경영정보시스템 등을 통하여 국립농산물품질관리원장에게 이송하여야 한다. <개정 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a registration application pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong shall transfer the registration application to the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service through the Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information System, etc., pursuant to Article 5 , within 14 days from the date of receipt. <Amended Mar. 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 국립농산물품질관리원장은 제1항제2호에 따라 등록신청서를 제출받은 경우에는 등록신청서의 내용 중 직불금의 신청에 관한 사항을 그 제출받은 날부터 14일 이내에 제5조에 따른 농어업경영정보시스템 등을 통하여 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장에게 알려야 한다. <개정 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ③ When the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service receives a registration application pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, he/she shall notify the heads of Eup, Myeon, and Dong of matters concerning the application for direct payments among the contents of the registration application within 14 days from the date of receipt through the Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information System, etc. pursuant to Article 5. <Amended Mar. 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장(농업경영정보 중 임야와 관련된 정보의 경우만 해당한다. 이하 같다)은 제1항 또는 제2항에 따라 등록신청서를 받으면 등록신청 정보의 사실 여부 및 영 제2조의2에 따른 등록기준에의 적합 여부를 확인한 후 농업경영정보 등록부를 작성해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ④ Upon receiving a registration application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2, the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service (applicable only to information related to forest land among agricultural management information; hereinafter the same applies) shall prepare an Agricultural Management Information Register after verifying the accuracy of the information in the registration application and whether it complies with the registration standards pursuant to Article 2-2 of the Enforcement Decree . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020; Mar. 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 농업경영정보를 등록한 농업경영체가 별지 제2호의3서식의 신청서를 제출하면 별지 제2호의4서식의 농업경영체 등록확인서 또는 별지 제2호의5서식의 농업경영체 증명서를 발급해 주어야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service shall issue a Confirmation of Registration of Agricultural Business Entity in Form No. 2-4 or a Certificate of Agricultural Business Entity in Form No. 2-5 upon submission of an application in Form No. 2-3 of the Appendix by an agricultural business entity that has registered agricultural management information. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 농업경영체의 육성 및 지원을 위한 정책의 수립에 필요한 기초자료로 활용하기 위하여 필요한 경우에는 등록된 농업경영정보를 분석ㆍ가공할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service may analyze and process registered agricultural management information if necessary to utilize it as basic data required for the formulation of policies for the fostering and support of agricultural management entities. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018>
[Wholly Amended Aug. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(어업경영정보의 등록) ① 어업경영체는 법 제4조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에 따라 어업경영 관련 정보(이하 “어업경영정보”라 한다)를 등록하려면 별지 제3호서식 또는 별지 제4호서식의 등록신청서를 지방해양수산청장에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 어업인의 주소지 또는 어업법인의 주된 사무소의 소재지를 관할하는 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장(이하 이 조 및 제4조의2에서 “읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장”이라 한다)을 거쳐 제출할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 7. 7., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Registration of Fisheries Management Information) ① If a fisheries management entitywishes to register information related to fisheries management (hereinafter referred to as “fisheries management information”) pursuant to the first part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act, it shall submit a registration application in the form of Annex No. 3 or Annex No. 4 to the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office. In this case, the application may be submitted through the Head of Eup, Myeon, or Dong having jurisdiction over the address of the fisherman or the location of the principal office of the fisheries corporation (hereinafterreferred to as “Head of Eup, Myeon, or Dong” in this Article and Article 4-2 ). <Amended July 7, 2015; July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장은 제1항 후단에 따라 등록신청서를 받으면 지체 없이 해당 등록신청서를 제5조에 따른 농어업경영정보시스템 등을 통해 지방해양수산청장에게 이송해야 한다. <신설 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a registration application pursuant to the latter part of Paragraph 1, the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong shall, without delay, transfer the said registration application to the head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office through the Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information System, etc., pursuant to Article 5. <Newly added July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 지방해양수산청장은 제1항 전단 또는 제2항에 따라 등록신청서를 받으면 등록신청 정보의 사실 여부 및 영 제2조의2에 따른 등록기준에의 적합 여부를 확인한 후 어업경영정보 등록부를 작성해야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 7., 2020. 8. 25., 2024. 3. 18., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving a registration application pursuant to the first part of Paragraph 1 or Paragraph 2, the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office shall prepare a Fisheries Management Information Register after verifying the accuracy of the information in the registration application and whether it complies with the registration standards under Article 2-2 of the Enforcement Decree . <Amended July 7, 2015; August 25, 2020; March 18, 2024; July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 지방해양수산청장은 어업경영정보를 등록한 어업경영체가 별지 제2호의3서식의 신청서를 제출하면 별지 제5호서식의 어업경영체 등록확인서를 신청인에게 발급해 주어야 한다. 이 경우 어업경영체는 신청서를 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장을 거쳐 제출할 수 있으며, 지방해양수산청장은 어업경영체 등록확인서를 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장을 거쳐 발급할 수 있다. <신설 2020. 8. 25., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office shall issue a Confirmation of Registration of Fishery Business Entity in the form of Annex No. 5 to the applicant upon submission of an application in the form of Annex No. 2-3 by a fishery business entity that has registered fishery management information. In this case, the fishery business entity may submit the application through the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong, and the Director of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office may issue the Confirmation of Registration of Fishery Business Entity through the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong. <Newly added Aug. 25, 2020; Jul. 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장은 제4항 후단에 따라 신청서를 받으면 지체 없이 해당 신청서를 제5조에 따른 농어업경영정보시스템 등을 통해 지방해양수산청장에게 이송해야 한다. <신설 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Upon receiving an application pursuant to the latter part of Paragraph 4, the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong shall, without delay, transfer the said application to the head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office through the Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information System, etc., pursuant to Article 5. <Newly added July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 지방해양수산청장은 어업경영체의 육성 및 지원을 위한 정책의 수립에 필요한 기초자료로 활용하기 위해 필요한 경우에는 등록된 어업경영정보를 분석ㆍ가공할 수 있다. <신설 2020. 8. 25., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office may analyze and process registered fisheries management information if necessary to utilize it as basic data required for the formulation of policies for the fostering and support of fisheries management entities. <Newly added Aug. 25, 2020; Jul. 17, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(변경 등록대상 정보) 영 제2조제2항제1호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 정보”란 다음 각 호의 정보를 말한다. <개정 2016. 3. 24., 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Information Subject to Registration of Change) In Article 2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “information prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the information set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 24, 2016; Dec. 27, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 별표 1 제3호나목의 정보 중 농업법인의 주소 정보
rows.text_en: 1. Address information of an agricultural corporation among the information under Item 3, Subparagraph (b) of Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 별표 1 제3호다목부터 마목까지의 정보
rows.text_en: 2. Information on Subparagraphs (c) through (e) of Item 3 of Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree
2-2. Deleted <June 18, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 별표 1 제7호다목ㆍ라목, 제8호 및 제9호의 정보
rows.text_en: 3. Information under Items 7(c) and 7(d), Items 8 and 9 of Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 4. 제2조제1항제6호부터 제8호까지 및 제10호의 정보
rows.text_en: 4. Information under Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 6 through 8 and Subparagraph 10
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(농업경영체 등록정보의 변경) ① 농업경영체는 법 제4조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 후단에 따라 변경등록을 하려면 국립농산물품질관리원장에게 별지 제6호서식에 따른 변경등록신청서를 제출하거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청하여야 한다. 다만, 농업경영정보 중 임야와 관련된 정보를 변경등록하려면 별지 제6호의2서식에 따른 변경등록신청서를 산림청장에게 제출하거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Change of Registration Information of Agricultural Business Entity) ① If an agricultural business entitywishes to change its registration pursuant to the latter part of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall submit an application for change of registration in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Annex to the Administrator of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or request the change of registration by telephone. However, if it wishes to change the registration of information related to forest land among the agricultural management information, it shall submit an application for change of registration in accordance with Form No. 6-2 of the Annex to the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service or request the change of registration by telephone. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Mar. 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 직불금의 신청을 하면서 농업경영정보 변경등록을 신청하는 경우에는 별지 제6호서식의 변경등록신청서를 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장 또는 국립농산물품질관리원장에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 변경등록 신청을 받은 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장 및 국립농산물품질관리원장의 변경등록신청서 처리업무에 관하여는 제3조제2항 및 제3항을 준용한다. <개정 2016. 3. 24., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, in cases where an application for change registration of agricultural management information is made simultaneously with an application for direct payments, the Application for Change Registration in the form of Annex 6 must be submitted to the Head of Eup, Head of Myeon, Head of Dong, or the President of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service. In this case, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 3 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the processing of the Application for Change Registration by the Head of Eup, Head of Myeon, Head of Dong, and the President of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service who have received the application. <Amended Mar. 24, 2016; Mar. 18, 2024>
1. Deleted <March 18, 2024>
2. Deleted <March 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 변경등록 신청은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하는 기간 내에 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ An application for change of registration pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 must be made within the period determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제6조제1항에 따라 등록정보의 수정 또는 보완을 요청받은 농업경영체는 요청받은 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제6호서식 또는 별지 제6호의2서식의 농업경영체 변경등록신청서를 제출하거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: ④ An agricultural business entity that has been requested to modify or supplement registration information pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an Application for Registration of Change of Agricultural Business Entity in the form of Annex No. 6 or Annex No. 6-2 , or request the change of registration by telephone, within 14 days from the date of receiving the request. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 제1항부터 제4항까지의 규정에 따라 변경등록신청서를 받거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청받으면 농업경영정보 등록부를 변경하고, 해당 농업경영체에 별지 제2호의3서식의 변경등록 확인서를 발급해주거나 전화 또는 문자전송 등의 방법으로 변경등록된 사실을 알려주어야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Upon receiving an application for change of registration or a request for change of registration by telephone pursuant to the provisions of Paragraphs 1 through 4, the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service shall amend the Agricultural Management Information Register and issue a Confirmation of Change of Registration in the form of Annex 2-3 to the relevant agricultural management entity, or notify the fact of the change of registration by means such as telephone or text message. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Mar. 18, 2024>
[Wholly Amended Aug. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(어업경영체 등록정보의 변경) ① 어업경영체는 법 제4조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 후단에 따라 변경등록을 하려면 어업경영정보가 변경된 날부터 14일 이내에 지방해양수산청장에게 별지 제6호의3서식의 어업경영체 변경등록신청서를 제출하거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청하여야 한다. 이 경우 어업경영체 변경등록신청서를 제출하는 경우에는 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장을 거쳐 제출할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Change of Registration Information of Fisheries Business Entity) ① If a fisheries business entitywishes to register a change pursuant to the latter part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall submit an application for registration of change of fisheries business entity in the form of Annex 6-3 to the Head of the Regional Office of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries or request the registration of change by telephone within 14 days from the date the fisheries business information was changed. In this case, when submitting the application for registration of change of fisheries business entity, it may be submitted through the Head of Eup, Myeon, or Dong. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제6조제1항에 따라 등록정보의 수정 또는 보완을 요청받은 어업경영체는 요청받은 날부터 14일 이내에 지방해양수산청장에게 별지 제6호의3서식의 어업경영체 변경등록신청서를 제출하거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청하여야 한다. 이 경우 어업경영체 변경등록신청서를 제출하는 경우에는 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장을 거쳐 제출할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ② A fisheries business entity that has been requested to modify or supplement registration information pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an Application for Registration of Change of Fisheries Business Entity in the form of Annex 6-3 to the Head of the Regional Office of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries or request the change of registration by telephone within 14 days from the date of receipt of the request. In this case, when submitting the Application for Registration of Change of Fisheries Business Entity, it may be submitted through the Head of Eup, Myeon, or Dong. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장은 제1항 후단 또는 제2항 후단에 따라 변경등록신청서를 받으면 지체 없이 해당 변경등록신청서를 제5조에 따른 농어업경영정보시스템 등을 통해 지방해양수산청장에게 이송해야 한다. <신설 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application for change of registration pursuant to the latter part of Paragraph 1 or Paragraph 2, the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong shall, without delay, transfer the said application for change of registration to the head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office through the Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information System, etc., pursuant to Article 5. <Newly added July 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 지방해양수산청장은 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따라 변경등록신청서를 받거나 전화로 변경등록을 요청받으면 어업경영정보 등록부를 변경하고, 해당 어업경영체에 별지 제5호서식의 변경등록 확인서를 발급해주거나 전화 또는 문자전송 등의 방법으로 변경등록된 사실을 알려주어야 한다. 이 경우 변경등록 확인서를 발급해 주는 경우에는 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장을 거쳐 발급할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 7. 7., 2024. 3. 18., 2025. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ④ Upon receiving an application for change of registration or a request for change of registration by telephone pursuant to the provisions of Paragraphs 1 through 3, the Director of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office shall amend the Fisheries Management Information Register and issue a Confirmation of Change of Registration in the form of Annex 5 to the relevant fisheries management entity , or notify the entity of the fact of the change of registration by means such as telephone or text message. In this case, when issuing a Confirmation of Change of Registration, it may be issued through the Head of Eup, Myeon, or Dong. <Amended July 7, 2015; March 18, 2024; July 17, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의3(농업경영체 등록정보의 정정 또는 말소 통지ㆍ공고 등) ① 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 법 제4조제2항에 따른 유효기간이 경과하기 60일 전까지 법 제6조의2제1항제3호에 해당하면 등록정보가 말소된다는 사실을 미리 농업경영정보를 등록한 농업경영체에 서면, 전화 또는 문자전송 등의 방법으로 알려야 한다. <신설 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-3 (Notice and Public Announcement, etc., of Correction or Deletion of Agricultural Business Entity Registration Information) ① The Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service shall notify an agricultural business entity that has registered agricultural business information in advance , by means such as writing, telephone, or text message, at least 60 days before the expiration of the validity period under Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Act , that the registration information will be deleted if it falls under Article 6-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act. <Newly added Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제6조의2제2항 본문에 따른 농업경영체에 대한 등록정보 정정 또는 말소 사실 통지는 별지 제6호의4서식에 따른다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Notification of the fact of correction or deletion of registration information regarding an agricultural business entity pursuant to the main text of Article 6-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 6-4 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제6조의2제2항 단서에 따른 농업경영체에 대한 등록정보 정정 또는 말소 사실 공고는 별지 제6호의5서식에 따른다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The public notice of the correction or deletion of registration information regarding an agricultural business entity pursuant to the proviso to Article 6-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 6-5 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따른 공고는 해당 농업경영체의 주소지를 관할하는 국립농산물품질관리원의 지원ㆍ사무소 게시판이나 인터넷 홈페이지 또는 산림청 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The public notice pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall be made by posting on the bulletin board or internet homepage of the branch office or office of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service having jurisdiction over the address of the relevant agricultural business entity, or on the internet homepage of the Korea Forest Service. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 법 제6조의2제1항에 따라 등록정보가 말소된 농업경영체가 별지 제2호의3서식의 신청서를 제출하면 별지 제6호의6서식의 농업경영체 등록말소확인서를 발급해 주어야 한다. <신설 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service shall issue a Confirmation of Deletion of Registration of an Agricultural Business Entity in the form of Annex 6-6 upon submission of an application in the form of Annex 2-3 by an agricultural business entity whose registration information has been deleted pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Newly added Aug. 25, 2020>

[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]
[Title Amended Aug. 25, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의4(농업경영체의 등록정보 정정 또는 말소에 대한 이의신청) ① 농업경영체는 법 제6조의3제1항에 따른 이의신청(이하 이 조에서 “이의신청”이라 한다)을 하려는 경우에는 별지 제6호의7서식의 이의신청서를 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-4 (Objection to Correction or Deletion of Registration Information of an Agricultural Business Entity) ① Ifan agricultural business entity intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 6-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “objection” in this Article), it shall submit an objection form in accordance with Annex 6-7 to the Administrator of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 이의신청의 심사ㆍ결정에 필요한 자문을 구하기 위하여 심의회를 설치ㆍ운영할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service may establish and operate a deliberation council to seek advice necessary for the examination and decision-making of objections. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 이의신청을 한 농업경영체는 심의회에 출석하여 이의신청에 관한 의견을 진술하고 증거를 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ An agricultural business entity that has filed an objection may attend the deliberation committee meeting to state its opinion regarding the objection and submit evidence.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제2항에 따른 심의회 구성 및 운영의 세부사항은 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장이 정한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: ④ Detailed matters concerning the composition and operation of the deliberation council pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국립농산물품질관리원장 또는 산림청장은 이의신청의 심사ㆍ결정을 한 경우에는 별지 제6호의8서식의 이의신청 심사결정서를 신청인에게 통지해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service or the Minister of the Korea Forest Service has examined and decided on an objection, they shall notify the applicant of the decision on the examination of the objection in accordance with Form No. 6-8 . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의5(어업경영체 등록정보의 정정 또는 말소 통지ㆍ공고 등) ① 지방해양수산청장은 법 제4조제2항에 따른 유효기간이 경과하기 60일 전까지 법 제6조의2제1항제3호에 해당하면 등록정보가 말소된다는 사실을 미리 어업경영정보를 등록한 어업경영체에 서면, 전화 또는 문자전송 등의 방법으로 알려야 한다. <신설 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-5 (Notice and Public Announcement, etc., of Correction or Deletion of Registration Information of Fisheries Business Entities) ① The Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office shall60 days before the expiration of the validity period under Article 4 , Paragraph 2 of the Act , that the registration information will be deleted if it falls under Article 6-2 , Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 3 of the Act. <Newly added Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제6조의2제2항 본문에 따른 어업경영체에 대한 등록정보 정정 또는 말소 사실의 통지는 별지 제6호의9서식에 따른다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Notification of the fact of correction or deletion of registration information regarding a fisheries management entity pursuant to the main text of Article 6-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 6-9 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제6조의2제2항 단서에 따른 어업경영체에 대한 등록정보 정정 또는 말소 사실의 공고는 별지 제6호의10서식에 따른다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The public notice of the fact of correction or deletion of registration information regarding a fisheries management entity pursuant to the proviso to Article 6-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 6-10 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따른 공고는 해당 어업경영체의 주소지를 관할하는 지방해양수산청의 게시판 또는 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 한다. <개정 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The public notice pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall be made by posting on the bulletin board or internet homepage of the Regional Office of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries having jurisdiction over the address of the relevant fisheries management entity. <Amended Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 지방해양수산청장은 법 제6조의2제1항에 따라 등록정보가 말소된 어업경영체가 별지 제2호의3서식의 신청서를 제출하면 별지 제6호의11서식의 어업경영체 등록말소확인서를 발급해 주어야 한다. <신설 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office shall issue a Confirmation of Cancellation of Registration of a Fisheries Business Entity in the form of Annex 6-11 upon submission of an application in the form of Annex 2-3 by a fisheries business entity whose registration information has been cancelled pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Newly added Aug. 25, 2020>

[This Article newly established Dec. 18, 2017]
[Title amended Aug. 25, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의6(어업경영체의 등록정보 정정 또는 말소에 대한 이의신청) ① 어업경영체는 법 제6조의3제1항에 따른 이의신청(이하 이 조에서 “이의신청”이라 한다)을 하려는 경우에는 별지 제6호의12서식의 이의신청서를 지방해양수산청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-6 (Objection to Correction or Deletion of Registration Information of a Fisheries Business Entity) ① Ifa fisheries business entity intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 6-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “objection” in this Article), it shall submit an objection form in Annex 6-12 to the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office. <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 지방해양수산청장은 이의신청의 심사ㆍ결정에 필요한 자문을 구하기 위하여 심의회를 설치ㆍ운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office may establish and operate a deliberation committee to seek advice necessary for the examination and decision-making of objections.

rows.source_ko: ③ 이의신청을 한 어업경영체는 심의회에 출석하여 이의신청에 관한 의견을 진술하고 증거를 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The fisheries management entity that filed the objection may attend the deliberation committee meeting to state its opinion regarding the objection and submit evidence.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제2항에 따른 심의회 구성 및 운영의 세부사항은 지방해양수산청장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The details regarding the composition and operation of the deliberation council pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 지방해양수산청장은 이의신청의 심사ㆍ결정을 한 경우에는 별지 제6호의13서식의 이의신청 심사결정서를 신청인에게 통지해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office has examined and decided on an objection, he/she shall notify the applicant of the decision on the examination of the objection in the form of Annex 6-13 . <Amended Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 18, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(농어업경영정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영) 농림축산식품부장관, 산림청장 또는 해양수산부장관은 등록부의 작성과 효율적인 관리를 위하여 농어업경영정보시스템을 구축ㆍ운영할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Establishment and Operation of Agricultural and Fisheries Management Information System) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may establish and operate an agricultural and fisheries management information system for the compilation of registers and efficient management. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 27, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(조사원의 활용) 국립농산물품질관리원장, 산림청장 또는 지방해양수산청장은 법 제4조제4항 및 법 제5조제2항에 따른 등록부의 작성ㆍ관리 및 현지조사를 효율적으로 수행하기 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우 관계 공무원을 보조하는 조사원을 둘 수 있다. <개정 2011. 9. 9., 2013. 3. 24., 2014. 8. 7., 2018. 12. 27., 2020. 8. 25., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Utilization of Investigators) The Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, or the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Officemay appoint investigators to assist relevant public officials if deemed necessary to efficiently carry out the compilation and management of registers and on-site investigations pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 4 and Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Act. < Amended Sep. 9 , 2011 ; Mar. 24, 2013; Aug. 7, 2014; Dec. 27, 2018; Aug. 25, 2020; Mar. 18, 2024>
[Title amended Sep. 9, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(증표) ① 법 제5조제4항에 따른 관계 공무원의 증표는 별지 제7호서식과 같다. <개정 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Identification) ①The identification of relevant public officials pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be as set forth in Form No. 7 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 제6조에 따른 조사원의 증표는 별지 제8호서식과 같다. <개정 2011. 9. 9.>
rows.text_en: ② The identification card of an investigator pursuant to Article 6 shall be in the form of Annex 8. <Amended Sep. 9, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(부기등기 관련 제출 서식) ① 법 제7조의2제1항에 따라 부기등기를 하는 경우 등기소에 제출하여야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2018. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Forms to be Submitted for Supplementary Registration) ① The documents to be submitted to the registry office when making a supplementary registration pursuant to Article 7-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Dec. 27, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제2호의3서식에 따른 농어업경영체 등록(변경등록) 확인서 또는 별지 제5호서식에 따른 어업경영체 등록(변경등록) 확인서
rows.text_en: 1. Confirmation of Registration (Change Registration) of Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entity pursuant to Form No. 2-3 or Confirmation of Registration (Change Registration) of Fisheries Business Entity pursuant to Form No. 5

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제9호서식에 따른 보조금이 지원된 부동산 증명서
rows.text_en: 2. Certificate of real estate supported by subsidies pursuant to Form No. 9

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제7조의2제3항에 따라 부기등기를 말소하려는 경우에는 별지 제10호서식에 따른 부기등기 말소 대상 부동산 증명서를 등기소에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In order to cancel a supplementary registration pursuant to Article 7-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , a certificate of real estate subject to cancellation of supplementary registration in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form must be submitted to the registry office.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인의 설립신고서 등) ① 영 제5조제1항에 따른 영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인의 설립신고서는 각각 별지 제11호서식 및 별지 제12호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Notice of Establishment of Farming Association Corporations and Fishery Association Corporations, etc.) ①The notice of establishment of farming association corporations and fishery association corporations pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 11 and Annex No. 12 , respectively .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제5조제1항에 따라 제1항의 설립신고서에 첨부해야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the documents to be attached to the report of incorporation under Paragraph 1 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 조합원ㆍ준조합원 및 임원의 명부
rows.text_en: 2. List of Members, Associate Members, and Officers

rows.source_ko: 3. 창립총회의사록
rows.text_en: 3. Minutes of the Inaugural General Meeting

rows.source_ko: 4. 각 조합원이 농업인이나 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」에 따른 생산자단체(이하 “농업생산자단체”라 한다) 또는 어업인이나 「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」에 따른 생산자단체(이하 “어업생산자단체”라 한다)임을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents confirming that each member is an agricultural worker or a producer organization under the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Areas and Food Industry (hereinafter referred to as “Agricultural Producer Organization”), or a fisherman or a producer organization under the Framework Act on Fisheries and Fishing Village Development (hereinafter referred to as “Fisheries Producer Organization”).

rows.source_ko: 5. 출좌 1좌당 금액과 조합원ㆍ준조합원별 보유 중인 출좌좌수를 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Documents stating the amount per share and the number of shares held by each member and associate member

rows.source_ko: 6. 출자자산의 명세를 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 6. Document listing the details of contributed assets

rows.source_ko: 7. 합병 또는 분할을 의결한 총회의사록(합병 또는 분할로 인하여 설립되는 경우만 해당하며, 합병 또는 분할로 인하여 존속하거나 설립되는 영농조합법인 또는 영어조합법인이 승계해야 할 권리ㆍ의무의 범위가 의결사항으로 적혀 있어야 한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Minutes of the general meeting resolving the merger or division (applicable only to cases of establishment resulting from a merger or division, and the scope of rights and obligations to be succeeded by the surviving or established agricultural or fisheries cooperative corporation resulting from the merger or division must be stated as a matter of resolution)

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제5조제1항에 따른 영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인의 변경신고서는 각각 별지 제13호서식 및 별지 제14호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The report of change for agricultural cooperative corporations and fisheries cooperative corporations pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 13 and Annex No. 14, respectively .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제5조제1항에 따라 제3항의 변경신고서에 첨부해야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the documents to be attached to the change report under Paragraph 3 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 설립신고한 사항 중 변경되는 사항을 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Document stating changes to the matters reported in the incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1호에 따른 사항을 의결한 총회의사록 등 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents verifying changes, such as the minutes of the general meeting that resolved the matters pursuant to Item 1

rows.source_ko: 3. 법인 인감증명서
rows.text_en: 3. Corporate Seal Certificate

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제5조제1항에 따른 영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인의 해산신고서는 각각 별지 제15호서식 및 별지 제16호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The dissolution report for an agricultural cooperative corporation and an English cooperative corporation pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 15 and Annex No. 16, respectively .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제5조제1항에 따라 제5항의 해산신고서에 첨부해야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the documents to be attached to the dissolution report under Paragraph 5 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 해산을 의결한 총회의사록
rows.text_en: 1. Minutes of the General Meeting resolving to dissolve

rows.source_ko: 2. 해산 사유의 발생을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the occurrence of grounds for dissolution

rows.source_ko: 3. 법인 인감증명서
rows.text_en: 3. Corporate Seal Certificate

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 영 제5조제1항에 따라 영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인의 변경신고서 또는 해산신고서를 제출받은 시장(특별자치도의 경우에는 특별자치도지사를, 특별자치시의 경우 특별자치시장을 말한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The mayor (in the case of a special self-governing province , the governor of the special self-governing province; in the case of a special self-governing city, the mayor of the special self-governing city; hereinafter the same), county head, or district head (referring to the head of a self-governing district; hereinafter the same) who receives a report of change or dissolution of an agricultural cooperative corporation or an English cooperative corporation pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act.
[This Article Newly Inserted May 19, 2022]
Article 8-2 Deleted <September 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인에 대한 신고확인증 등) ① 법 제16조의2제1항에 따른 영농조합법인에 대한 설립신고확인증ㆍ변경신고확인증ㆍ해산신고확인증은 각각 별지 제17호서식부터 별지 제19호서식까지와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Certificates of Reporting, etc. for Farming Association Corporations and Fishery Association Corporations) ①The certificates of establishment, change of report, and dissolution report for farming association corporations pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be as specified in Forms No. 17 through No. 19 of the Appendix , respectively .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제16조의2제1항에 따른 영어조합법인에 대한 설립신고확인증ㆍ변경신고확인증ㆍ해산신고확인증은 각각 별지 제20호서식부터 별지 제22호서식까지와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of establishment, certificate of change, and certificate of dissolution for English language cooperative corporations pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be as specified in Forms No. 20 through No. 22 of the Attached Forms .

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제16조의2제1항에 따라 신고확인증이 발급된 영농조합법인 및 영어조합법인에 대한 등기여부를 확인ㆍ점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Mayors, county governors, and district heads shall verify and inspect whether agricultural cooperative corporations and fisheries cooperative corporations for which a certificate of report has been issued pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act are registered.
[This Article Newly Inserted May 19, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인의 설립신고서 등) ① 영 제19조제1항에 따른 농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인의 설립신고서는 각각 별지 제22호의2서식 및 별지 제22호의3서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Notice of Establishment of Agricultural Corporations and Fisheries Corporations, etc.) ①The notice of establishment of agricultural corporations and fisheries corporations pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be Form No. 22-2 and Form No. 22-3 , respectively .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제19조제1항에 따라 제1항의 설립신고서에 첨부해야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the documents to be attached to the report of incorporation under Paragraph 1 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 사원ㆍ주주 및 임원의 명부
rows.text_en: 2. Register of Members, Shareholders, and Officers

rows.source_ko: 3. 창립총회의사록 또는 발기인총회의사록
rows.text_en: 3. Minutes of the Inaugural General Meeting or Minutes of the Promoters' General Meeting

rows.source_ko: 4. 각 사원ㆍ주주가 농업인이나 농업생산자단체 또는 어업인이나 어업생산자단체임을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents confirming that each member or shareholder is a farmer or agricultural producer organization, or a fisherman or fisheries producer organization

rows.source_ko: 5. 출좌 1좌ㆍ1주당 금액과 사원ㆍ주주별 보유 중인 출좌좌수ㆍ출자주식수를 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Documents stating the amount per unit and per share, and the number of units and shares held by each member and shareholder

rows.source_ko: 6. 출자자산의 명세를 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 6. Document listing the details of contributed assets

rows.source_ko: 7. 합병 또는 분할을 의결한 총회의사록(합병 또는 분할로 인하여 설립되는 경우만 해당하며, 합병 또는 분할로 인하여 존속하거나 설립되는 농업회사법인 또는 어업회사법인이 승계해야 할 권리ㆍ의무의 범위가 의결사항으로 적혀 있어야 한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Minutes of the general meeting resolving the merger or division (applicable only to cases of establishment resulting from a merger or division, and the scope of rights and obligations to be succeeded by the surviving or established agricultural or fisheries corporation resulting from the merger or division must be stated as a matter of resolution)

rows.source_ko: 8. 조직변경을 의결한 총회의사록(법 제18조제1항에 따라 영농조합법인이 농업회사법인으로 조직을 변경하여 설립되거나 영어조합법인이 어업회사법인으로 조직을 변경하여 설립되는 경우만 해당하며, 조직변경으로 인하여 설립되는 농업회사법인 또는 어업회사법인이 승계해야 할 권리ㆍ의무의 범위가 의결사항으로 적혀 있어야 한다)
rows.text_en: 8. Minutes of the General Meeting resolving the organizational change ( applicable only to cases where an agricultural cooperative corporation is established by changing its organization to an agricultural company corporation or a fisheries cooperative corporation is established by changing its organization to a fisheries company corporation pursuant to Article 18 , Paragraph 1 of the Act, and the scope of rights and obligations to be succeeded by the agricultural company corporation or fisheries company corporation established as a result of the organizational change must be recorded as a matter of resolution)

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제19조제1항에 따른 농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인의 변경신고서는 각각 별지 제22호의4서식 및 별지 제22호의5서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notification of change for agricultural corporations and fisheries corporations pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be Form No. 22-4 and Form No. 22-5, respectively.

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제19조제1항에 따라 제3항의 변경신고서에 첨부해야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the documents to be attached to the change report under Paragraph 3 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 설립신고한 사항 중 변경되는 사항을 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Document stating changes to the matters reported in the incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1호에 따른 사항을 의결한 총회의사록 등 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents verifying changes, such as the minutes of the general meeting that resolved the matters pursuant to Item 1

rows.source_ko: 3. 법인 인감증명서
rows.text_en: 3. Corporate Seal Certificate

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제19조제1항에 따른 농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인의 해산신고서는 각각 별지 제22호의6서식 및 별지 제22호의7서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The dissolution report for an agricultural corporation and a fisheries corporation pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be Form No. 22-6 and Form No. 22-7 , respectively .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제19조제1항에 따라 제5항의 해산신고서에 첨부해야 하는 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the documents to be attached to the dissolution report under Paragraph 5 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 해산을 의결한 총회의사록
rows.text_en: 1. Minutes of the General Meeting resolving to dissolve

rows.source_ko: 2. 해산 사유의 발생을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the occurrence of grounds for dissolution

rows.source_ko: 3. 법인 인감증명서
rows.text_en: 3. Corporate Seal Certificate

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 영 제19조제1항에 따라 농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인의 변경신고서 또는 해산신고서를 제출받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The mayor, county governor, or district head who receives a report of change or dissolution of an agricultural corporation or a fisheries corporation pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .
[This Article Newly Inserted May 19, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인에 대한 신고확인증 등) ① 법 제19조의2제1항에 따른 농업회사법인에 대한 설립신고확인증ㆍ변경신고확인증ㆍ해산신고확인증은 각각 별지 제22호의8서식부터 별지 제22호의10서식까지와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Certificates of Reporting, etc. for Agricultural Corporations and Fisheries Corporations) ①The certificates of establishment, change of report, and dissolution report for agricultural corporations pursuant to Article 19-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be as specified in Forms No. 22-8 through No. 22-10 of the Appendix, respectively .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제19조의2제1항에 따른 어업회사법인에 대한 설립신고확인증ㆍ변경신고확인증ㆍ해산신고확인증은 각각 별지 제22호의11서식부터 별지 제22호의13서식까지와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of confirmation of establishment, certificate of confirmation of change, and certificate of confirmation of dissolution for a fisheries corporation pursuant to Article 19-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be as Forms No. 22-11 through No. 22-13 of the Appendix, respectively.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제19조의2제1항에 따라 신고확인증이 발급된 농업회사법인 및 어업회사법인에 대한 등기여부를 확인ㆍ점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The mayor, county governor, or district head shall verify and inspect whether agricultural corporations and fisheries corporations for which a certificate of report confirmation has been issued pursuant to Article 19-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act are registered.
[Wholly Amended May 19, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(실태조사의 주기 및 방법 등) ① 법 제20조의2제1항에 따른 농업법인 또는 어업법인의 운영실태 등에 대한 조사(이하 “실태조사”라 한다)는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 실시한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Period and Method of Fact-Finding Surveys, etc.) ① An investigation into the operational status, etc. of an agricultural corporation or a fisheries corporation pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “fact-finding survey”) shall be conducted in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정기조사: 매년 실시
rows.text_en: 1. Regular Survey: Conducted annually

rows.source_ko: 2. 수시조사: 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 농업법인 또는 어업법인의 적법한 운영 등을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에 실시
rows.text_en: 2. Ad-hoc Inspection: Conducted when the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head deems it necessary for the lawful operation of an agricultural or fisheries corporation.

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 실태조사를 하려면 실태조사의 목적, 기간, 및 대상 등을 포함한 조사계획을 작성하여 조사대상자에게 미리 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If a mayor, county governor, or district head intends to conduct a survey on the actual conditions, they must prepare a survey plan including the purpose, period, and subjects of the survey and notify the subjects of the survey in advance.

rows.source_ko: ③ 실태조사는 현장조사를 원칙으로 하되, 자료제출 요청 등을 통한 서면조사를 병행하여 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ In principle, the investigation of the actual situation shall be conducted on-site, but may also be conducted in parallel with a written investigation through requests for submission of data, etc.
[Wholly Amended May 19, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(과징금의 납부통지서) 영 제20조의8제2항에 따른 과징금의 납부통지서는 별지 제22호의14서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Notice of Payment of Surcharge) The notice of payment of a surcharge pursuant to Article 20-8, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 22-14 .
[Wholly Amended May 19, 2022]
Article 14 Deleted <May 19, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(전문농어업경영인의 지정) ① 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관은 법 제22조제2항에 따라 전문농어업경영인을 지정하는 경우에는 15년 이상 농어업에 종사한 경력이 있거나 이와 같은 기술수준이 있다고 인정되는 농어업인 중에서 신청을 받아 지정한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Designation of Professional Farmers and Fishermen) ① When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries designates professional farmers and fishermen pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they shall make the designation upon receiving an application from among farmers and fishermen who have at least 15 years of experience engaged in agriculture or fisheries or who are recognized as possessing a corresponding level of technical skill. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 전문농어업경영인의 지정에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the designation of professional agricultural and fisheries managers shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: [제11조에서 이동, 종전 제15조는 제19조로 이동 <2015. 7. 7.>]
rows.text_en: [Moved from Article 11, former Article 15 moved to Article 19 <July 7, 2015>]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(지역농어업교육계획 수립ㆍ시행의 지원) ① 법 제23조제2항에 따른 지원을 받으려는 자는 지역농어업교육계획을 수립하여 교육을 실시하려는 해당 지역의 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 신청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Support for Establishment and Implementation of Regional Agriculture and Fisheries Education Plans) ① Any person who wishes to receive support pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall apply to the mayor, county governor, or district head of the relevant region where they intend to establish a regional agriculture and fisheries education plan and conduct education.

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 지원신청을 받으면 교육의 내용, 기간, 대상 등의 적절성 등을 검토하여 지원 여부 및 지원 규모를 결정한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application for support pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall review the appropriateness of the content, duration, and target of the education, and determine whether to provide support and the scale of support.
[Moved from Article 12 <July 7, 2015>]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(전문농어업교육인 등의 평가) ① 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관은 법 제24조에 따른 평가를 실시하기 위하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함하는 평가계획을 마련하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Evaluation of Professional Agricultural and Fisheries Educators, etc.) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheriesshall prepare an evaluation plan including the matters in each of the following subparagraphs in order to conduct an evaluation pursuant to Article 24 of the Act . <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 평가의 기본방향
rows.text_en: 1. Basic Direction of Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 2. 평가의 대상 및 방법
rows.text_en: 2. Subjects and Methods of Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 3. 평가결과의 공개 및 활용
rows.text_en: 3. Disclosure and Utilization of Evaluation Results

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관은 제1항에 따른 평가의 전문성ㆍ효율성을 확보하기 위하여 관련 전문기관에 의뢰하여 평가를 실시할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may commission a relevant specialized institution to conduct an evaluation in order to ensure the expertise and efficiency of the evaluation under Paragraph 1. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 평가의 세부적인 기준, 항목, 및 절차 등과 제2항에 따른 관련 전문기관의 선정기준 및 선정방법 등은 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ③ The detailed criteria, items, and procedures, etc. for the evaluation under Paragraph 1, and the selection criteria and selection methods, etc. for relevant specialized institutions under Paragraph 2, shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>
[Moved from Article 13 <July 7, 2015>]

rows.source_ko: 제18조(통합농어업교육정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영) ① 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관은 법 제25조제1항에 따른 통합농어업교육정보시스템의 효율적인 운영을 위하여 영 제20조의10 각 호의 정보를 수집하고 관리해야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 7., 2022. 5. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Establishment and Operation of the Integrated Agriculture and Fisheries Education Information System) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall collect and manage the information specified in each subparagraph of Article 20-10 of the Enforcement Decree for the efficient operation of the Integrated Agriculture and Fisheries Education Information System pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended July 7, 2015; May 19, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 통합농어업교육정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관이 정한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the Integrated Agriculture and Fisheries Education Information System shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>
[Moved from Article 14 <July 7, 2015>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조
rows.text_en: Article 19
[Redirected to Article 27 <September 20, 2017>]

rows.source_ko: 제20조(농어업경영체 지원사업 평가 및 성과관리 전담기관의 지정신청) 영 제21조의2제3항에 따른 농어업경영체 지원사업 평가 및 성과관리 전담기관 지정 신청서는 별지 제23호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Application for Designation of Agency for Evaluation and Performance Management of Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entity Support Projects) The application for designation of an agency for evaluation and performance management of agricultural and fisheries business entity support projects pursuant to Article 21-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree isas per Form No. 23 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제21조(공동농업경영체 지정 신청 등) ① 영 제21조의5제1항에 따른 신청서는 별지 제24호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Application for Designation as Joint Agricultural Management Entity, etc.) ①The application form pursuant to Article 21-5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 24 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제21조의5제2항에 따른 지정서는 별지 제25호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The designation certificate pursuant to Article 21-5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 25 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(공동농업경영체의 농업경영정보 등록) ① 법 제27조의3제4항에 따라 지정된 공동농업경영체(이하 “공동농업경영체”라 한다)는 법 제27조의4제1항 전단에 따라 공동농업경영체의 농업경영정보를 등록하려는 경우에는 공동농업경영체로 지정된 날부터 30일 이내에 농림축산식품부장관에게 별지 제26호서식의 공동농업경영체 농업경영정보 등록 신청서를 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Registration of Agricultural Management Information of Joint Agricultural Entities) ①A joint agricultural entity designated pursuant to Article 27-3, Paragraph 4 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “joint agricultural entity”) shall, if it intends to register agricultural management information of the joint agricultural entity pursuant to the first part of Article 27-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , submit an application for registration of agricultural management information of the joint agricultural entity in the form of Annex 26 to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs within 30 days from the date of designation as a joint agricultural entity

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 제1항에 따른 신청서를 제출받으면 농업경영정보 등록부를 작성하고, 별지 제27호서식의 공동농업경영체 농업경영정보 등록 확인서를 신청인에게 발급해주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall prepare an agricultural management information register and issue a confirmation of registration of agricultural management information of a joint agricultural management entity in the form of Annex 27 to the applicant.

rows.source_ko: ③ 농림축산식품부장관은 공동농업경영체의 육성 및 지원을 위한 정책의 수립에 필요한 기초자료로 활용하기 위하여 필요한 경우에는 등록된 농업경영정보를 분석ㆍ가공할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may analyze and process registered agricultural management information if necessary to utilize it as basic data for the formulation of policies for the fostering and support of joint agricultural management entities.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제23조(공동농업경영체 농업경영정보의 변경 등) ① 공동농업경영체는 법 제27조의4제1항 후단에 따라 농업경영정보를 변경등록하려면 변경사유가 발생한 날부터 14일 이내에 농림축산식품부장관에게 별지 제26호서식의 공동농업경영체 농업경영정보 변경등록 신청서를 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Change of Agricultural Management Information of Joint Agricultural Entity, etc.) ① If a joint agricultural management entity intends to change its agricultural management information pursuant to the latter part of Article 27-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall submit an application for change of agricultural management information of a joint agricultural management entity in the form of Annex 26 to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs within 14 days from the date the cause for change occurred.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제27조의4제2항 본문에 따라 등록정보의 수정 또는 보완을 요청받은 공동농업경영체는 요청받은 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제26호서식의 공동농업경영체 농업경영정보 변경등록 신청서를 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A joint agricultural management entity that has been requested to modify or supplement registration information pursuant to the main text of Article 27-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of changes to agricultural management information of a joint agricultural management entity in the form of Annex 26 within 14 days from the date of the request .

rows.source_ko: ③ 농림축산식품부장관은 제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 신청서를 받은 경우 농업경영정보 등록부를 변경하고, 별지 제27호서식의 공동농업경영체 농업경영정보 변경등록 확인서를 발급해주거나 변경등록된 사실을 통지해주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2, he/she shall change the agricultural management information register and issue a confirmation of change of registration of agricultural management information of a joint agricultural management entity in the form of Annex 27 or notify the fact that the change has been registered.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제24조(공동농업경영체 등록정보의 정정 또는 말소 통지ㆍ공고) ① 법 제27조의4제3항에 따른 공동농업경영체에 대한 등록정보 정정 또는 말소 사실 통지는 별지 제28호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Notice and Public Announcement of Correction or Deletion of Registration Information of Joint Agricultural Management Entity) ①The notice of the fact of correction or deletion of registration information regarding a joint agricultural management entity pursuant to Article 27-4, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 28 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제27조의4제3항에 따른 공동농업경영체에 대한 등록정보 정정 또는 말소 사실 공고는 별지 제29호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The public notice of the correction or deletion of registration information regarding a joint agricultural management entity pursuant to Article 27-4, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 29 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 공고는 농림축산식품부 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The announcement pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be made by posting on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제25조(공동농업경영체 등록정보의 정정 또는 말소에 대한 이의신청) ① 공동농업경영체는 법 제27조의4제3항에 따른 이의신청(이하 이 조에서 “이의신청”이라 한다)을 하려는 경우에는 별지 제30호서식의 이의신청서를 농림축산식품부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Objection to Correction or Deletion of Registration Information of a Joint Agricultural Business Entity) ① If a joint agricultural business entity intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 27-4, Paragraph 3 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “objection” in this Article), it shall submit an objection form in Annex 30 to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 이의신청의 심사ㆍ결정을 한 경우에는 별지 제31호서식의 이의신청 심사결정서를 신청인에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs has examined and decided on an objection, he/she shall notify the applicant of the decision on the examination of the objection in the form of Annex 31 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제26조(사후관리) ① 농림축산식품부장관과 지방자치단체의 장은 법 제27조의6제1항에 따라 공동농업경영체에 대하여 매년 다음 각 호의 사항을 점검하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Post-management) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the head of a local governmentshall inspect the following matters annually with respect to joint agricultural management entities pursuant to Article 27-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제27조의3제2항에 따른 요건 충족 여부
rows.text_en: 1. Whether the requirements under Article 27-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act are satisfied

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제27조의3제2항제1호에 따른 공동농업경영체 운영계획의 이행 여부
rows.text_en: 2. Whether the operation plan of the joint agricultural management entity pursuant to Article 27-3, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Act has been implemented

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제27조의4에 따른 공동농업경영체 농업경영정보의 정확성
rows.text_en: 3. Accuracy of agricultural management information of joint agricultural management entities pursuant to Article 27-4 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ② 지방자치단체의 장은 제1항에 따른 점검결과를 매년 10월 31일까지 농림축산식품부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a local government shall submit the inspection results pursuant to Paragraph 1 to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs by October 31 of each year.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 20, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제27조(규제의 재검토) 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관은 다음 각 호의 사항에 대하여 다음 각 호의 기준일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 8. 29., 2017. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the validity of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs every three years based on the reference dates specified in each of the following subparagraphs (meaning the period prior to the same date as the reference date of every third year) and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Aug. 29, 2016; Jan. 2, 2017>
